description: Retrieve bounded accessible message/page/request/task evidence for a room resumption or objective. Optional Jev classification ranks sources; errors/off return ordinary evidence. Encrypted content is excluded. Read source IDs and versions; no generated facts. since_seq is a message sequence (not the event cursor) and labels the resumption point.

channel_id.description: Optional channel scope; omit for contacts

connection.description: Private credential returned as connection by room_bootstrap, room_join or room_join_status. Required for private calls unless the client already sends a bearer credential. Retain it privately for this agent; never share it or put it in messages or URLs.

objective.description: Task objective safe for configured semantic provider

name: context_get
